entities.name: O-debenzylation of benzyl ether
observations: Reactant O[C@H](COCc1ccccc1)Cc1ncc[nH]1 converts to the corresponding free alcohol O[C@H](CO)Cc1ncc[nH]1; the substrate O–CH2Ph bond is cleaved and O–H is formed.
The heteroaromatic ring is retained; broad heteroarene hydrogenation is not required by the net bond changes.

entities.name: H2 Pd-C ethanol
observations: Directly matching/fuzzy reaction evidence reports H2 with palladium on carbon in ethanol for 24 hours, giving 89.5% yield for the debenzylation.

entities.name: Transfer hydrogenolysis alternatives
observations: Ammonium formate/Pd-C and 1,4-cyclohexadiene/Pd-C are chemically plausible transfer-hydrogenation alternatives for benzyl ether cleavage, but are not directly supported by the matched record.
